effects.effect: At the start of an encounter, choose one creature within your [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect). You have a double [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [power rolls](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) made against or in competition with that creature. The chosen creature also has a double [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [power rolls](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) made against or in competition with you. If the chosen creature is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), you can choose a new foil at the start of the next [combat round](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/combat-round).
